column3: thread.archive sets an optional flag on xin.thread and the home projection and thread_list hide it; artifacts are one xin.artifacts doc per thread with a revision and a 10-artifact/1 MB bound, exposed as artifact.* ops and a tool-* row
column4: an archived thread must stay readable and its conversation must survive; a per-thread artifact map keeps reads and writes atomic with the transcript and avoids a new doc-family mechanism
column5: plugins/orchestrator/threads.ts thread.archive; plugins/artifacts/*; plugins/workspace/workspace.ts projection skip; gate fmt, lint, types, test and bundle green
column6: accepted; no comments and no old-revision history until a use case needs them
